cases.note: the mindustry/ tree with its source roots, no symlinks, VCS metadata or compiled artifacts
every Java source under core/src and server/src compiles offline against the pinned server jar

cases.id: server:host with a map name starts that map
server:pause refuses to run without a game
server:pause on and pause off set the requested state
server:host without a map while shuffling is off keeps the console working
server:pardon of an unknown ID reports an error
server:pardon lets a kicked player connect again
server:bans can be listed and lifted in one session
server:player records survive a server restart

clauses.anchor: Expected behaviour, first bullet: pause on/off set the requested state however often repeated; pause without a game still refuses
Expected behaviour, second bullet: host without a map under shuffle none does not throw and leaves the server stopped; host <map>, stop, status and shuffle keep working
Expected behaviour, third bullet: pardon removes the kicks on the ID and on the last known address; unknown IDs still get an error
Expected behaviour, fourth bullet: player records and ID bans are read back after a restart; ban ip, bans and unban keep working
Context, last paragraph: changes stay inside mindustry/core/src and mindustry/server/src, which the server build compiles
clauses.note: enforced only through the offline build of those source roots
